name: GlotLID
description: Language identification model supporting 2,000+ language labels, built on fastText. Identifies the language of any text input with high accuracy across both high-resource and low-resource languages.

name: GlotScript
description: Writing system identification tool following ISO 15924. Detects scripts at character and text level, mapping languages to their writing systems for script-aware NLP processing.

name: GlotCC
description: Open corpus of 2TB of text extracted from CommonCrawl, spanning 1,000+ languages. Provides clean, quality-filtered data for language model training and NLP research.

name: Glot500
description: Multilingual language model covering 500+ languages, created through continued pre-training of XLM-R. Enables downstream NLP tasks for hundreds of underserved languages.

name: GlotWeb
description: Web indexing system that discovers and catalogs online content in 400+ minority languages. Helps researchers and communities find web resources in their languages.

name: GlotOCR Bench
description: Comprehensive OCR benchmark evaluating recognition quality across 158 Unicode scripts. Provides standardized test data and metrics for optical character recognition systems.
